description: Defines base classes and templates for testing HTTP/2 payload decoders in the quiche project, including methods for starting, resuming, and validating payload decoding, as well as handling padding and frame size errors.

classes.name: PayloadDecoderBaseTest
classes.description: Base class for testing payload decoders, providing interface methods for starting, resuming, and preparing decoders, as well as managing frame headers and decoder state.

classes.name: AbstractPayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Template class for testing specific payload decoders, managing decoder setup, flags, and validation routines.

classes.name: AbstractPaddablePayloadDecoderTest
classes.description: Template class for testing payload decoders that support padding, parameterized by total padding length.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Final method to start decoding payload, calls the decoder's StartDecodingPayload.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Final method to resume decoding payload, calls the decoder's ResumeDecodingPayload.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes a payload with various partitionings and validates the output against expected frame parts.

methods.name: VerifyDetectsFrameSizeError
methods.description: Checks that decoding a payload results in a frame size error, validating error handling.

methods.name: VerifyDetectsMultipleFrameSizeErrors
methods.description: Validates detection of frame size errors across multiple payload sizes and padding configurations.

methods.name: VerifyDetectsPaddingTooLong
methods.description: Checks that padding length errors are correctly detected during decoding.
